originality_review: Original. The 'delivery photo' device is our own. It uses a generic, fictional app UI with no real courier branding.
scores_basis: Initial editorial judgement, 2026-11-19. topic_demand is an estimate linked to research/WEEKLY_TREND_REPORT.md categories, not a measurement of this concept.
concept: Jun's parcel is 'handed to resident' while nobody is home. The courier photo shows someone in his hoodie on his bed. Live app updates reveal something living in his room, photographing him from behind.

hooks.line: My parcel was delivered. To the person in my bed.
hooks.first_visual: A parcel app screen: DELIVERED, handed to resident, with a photo of a bedroom.

hooks.line: Nobody was home. Someone signed for it.
hooks.first_visual: An empty flat, a phone pinging.

hooks.line: In the delivery photo, someone's wearing my hoodie.
hooks.first_visual: A cropped photo: lime hoodie cords, hands holding a box.

hooks.line: Now the app says my parcel's been opened.
The new photo was taken from behind me.
hooks.first_visual: A phone photo of a teen holding his phone, from behind.

conflict: Jun needs to know who is in his room.
escalation: Delivered, opened, then a new photo taken right now.
reveal: The latest photo shows Jun from behind, standing where he stands.
visual_requirements: parcel app UI (E7, post motion graphics)
